title: Hall without a name on the plan

model.line: On the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class, its form drawn by the hall kit. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 6.41 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

by the hall kit: 2 bays, a porch front and back, steps on the front, 硬山 flush gable with a rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile, a painted beam under the eave. Drawn from the typology of its hall class, not from a picture of this hall (assumed, C).

searched: This block has no name on the plan or in the texts, so no source can be searched for it by name.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01) with no label, 2x1 cells: a building stood here, its name unknown.
